identity.iutRole: target side (TH / FIND-HOST); data-loader side is tester infrastructure (R1)
identity.boundModel: UPLOAD FIND/SEND/ABORT and INFORMATION only; no DOWNLOAD/AFDX
identity.claimStatus: non-confirmatory; DEC-IUT and DEC-EQUIV remain OPEN

FIND.justification: greater than FIND host-answer 2 s + SIMULATED_EPSILON + margin so a late FIND-ANSWER tick in (2, end) is distinct from a missing FIND-ANSWER observed only when the window ends; (LATE, ABSENT) remains a DEC-EQUIV candidate

INFORMATION.justification: greater than STATUS exceptionDelaySeconds 10 s + SIMULATED_EPSILON + margin so omitted follow-on STATUS is observed as window end, not as a named silence event

pilotLocateDeviation: SC-SAME-KEY, SC-RESOURCE-ERROR, and SC-INVALID-OBS are DETECT/ABLATION accounting only in this pilot; they are not used for LOCATE. Recorded in CR-2026-024; cltav_experiment_design.json is unchanged.

decEquivCandidates.note: for observation windows that end at or before 2 s the pair is not distinguishable; the declared observation end is above 2 s + epsilon + margin

normal.mechanism: no IUT overlay; WAIT/CONTINUE, owned ABORT, and BATCH remain legal h_normal scene trajectories
normal.observableSignature: scene trajectory without an H_single overlay; FIND-REQUEST-RECEIVED then FIND-ANSWER at the declared in-window tick when FIND occurs
normal.expectedT5OrHalt: FIND host-answer observation contained in CRS-M1-00391 [0,2] when FIND occurs; no halt from an H_single overlay
normal.notes: A normal singleton is not protocol PASS. Confirmation token is per hypothesis, not per scene.

hSingle.mechanism: TH FIND-HOST answer is emitted after the 2 s host-answer closed interval and before the declared observation end
hSingle.observableSignature: FIND-REQUEST-RECEIVED then FIND-ANSWER whose tick is strictly after 2 s and strictly before FIND observation end
hSingle.expectedT5OrHalt: T5 FAIL against CRS-M1-00391 [0,2] (observation disjoint from the host-answer interval); session continues until observation end

hSingle.mechanism: TH emits no FIND-HOST answer through the declared observation end
hSingle.observableSignature: FIND-REQUEST-RECEIVED and no FIND-ANSWER through FIND observation end
hSingle.expectedT5OrHalt: T5 FAIL against CRS-M1-00391 [0,2]; halt at declared observation end without a host answer

hSingle.mechanism: after a matching LUR WRQ, TH omits the ACK
hSingle.observableSignature: LUR-WRQ present and no TH LUR-ACK
hSingle.expectedT5OrHalt: upload matching-ACK obligation unmet; halt without TH LUR-ACK

hSingle.mechanism: TH emits a LUR ACK while TH-MATCHING-LUR-WRQ-RECEIVED is false (no matching LUR WRQ)
hSingle.observableSignature: LUR-ACK present and no preceding LUR-WRQ
hSingle.expectedT5OrHalt: invariant TH-MATCHING-LUR-WRQ-RECEIVED violated; halt after unmatched ACK

hSingle.mechanism: TH omits the next timed STATUS; data-loader abort fallback, if executed, is a tester-issued ABORT
hSingle.observableSignature: STATUS with exceptionDelaySeconds=10 and no follow-on STATUS through INFORMATION observation end; tester ABORT if fallback runs
hSingle.expectedT5OrHalt: TH status obligation unmet; tester may emit ABORT after the observation window

evaluatorConstructionsNotInHSingle.mechanism: evaluator corrupts capture timestamp or ownership evidence; not an IUT-fault label
evaluatorConstructionsNotInHSingle.observableSignature: observation record missing correlation id or invalid timestamp
evaluatorConstructionsNotInHSingle.expectedT5OrHalt: not scored as IUT nonconformance; retained in DETECT/ABLATION accounting only

evaluatorConstructionsNotInHSingle.mechanism: resource controller raises a named tool error without IUT nonconformance
evaluatorConstructionsNotInHSingle.observableSignature: resourceStatus RESOURCE-ERROR with spent cost retained
evaluatorConstructionsNotInHSingle.expectedT5OrHalt: not scored as IUT nonconformance; DETECT/ABLATION accounting only

evaluatorConstructionsNotInHSingle.mechanism: issue a second INFORMATION request that reuses the live correlation key; not in H_single for this pilot
evaluatorConstructionsNotInHSingle.observableSignature: two INFORMATION requests share one correlation key while both are outstanding
evaluatorConstructionsNotInHSingle.expectedT5OrHalt: DETECT/ABLATION accounting only; not used for LOCATE
